messages:
Zoe (AE): Quick: InsurePay wants a 30-day Dedicated POC in us-west-2. Must give a stable egress IP for their firewall. They also asked if we can provide a DNS alias they can pin and who handles mTLS cert rotation. Need a procurement line: '30d Dedicated POC + mTLS ops'. cc @Ken @Hana

Ken (Solutions): We support EIP(s) per Dedicated pool. Options: single EIP (fast) or two for redundancy. We can publish a DNS alias but advise allowlisting IPs. mTLS supported; one-time ops setup required to pin CA/client certs. Need QPS to quote.

Hana (Network): Network facts: outbound NAT uses allocated EIPs per pool. We'll hand over /32s for firewall allowlist. DNS alias (e.g., insure-<id>.egress.redwood.example) can be provided but IPs are authoritative. TLS only 443, SNI required.

Vik (Infra): Provisioning kicked off for small pool in us-west-2. Reserving 1 EIP per request; can add second. ETA ~90 minutes. Will post real IPs here.

Rosa (Security): For procurement: SOC2 available. mTLS: customer supplies CA bundle and rotation plan; they own cert rotation and must notify ops 72h before swap. For Dedicated we manage endpoint TLS keys unless they opt for Private.

Ken (Solutions): Proposed POC steps: 1) customer confirms single vs dual EIP and provides QPS. 2) if mTLS: send CA bundle + rotation contact. 3) we provision pool and share IP(s) + optional DNS alias. 4) customer allowlists IP(s) on TCP 443 and smoke-tests with curl.

infra-bot: provisioning requested: dedicated small pool in us-west-2. ETA ~90m. Reserving 1 EIP.

Hana (Network): Placeholder firewall rule for their team: Allow outbound TCP 443 to 203.0.113.250/32 (placeholder). Test command once you have the POC key:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" --resolve dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example:443:203.0.113.250 "https://dedicated-us-west-2.redwood.example/v1/chat" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}]}'
```

Vik (Infra): IP assigned: 203.0.113.250 (reserved). If they want HA we can add .251.

Zoe (AE): Sending procurement the line item and SOC2. I'll ask if they accept single-IP risk or want two. Ken  please send the 30d quote + mTLS ops fee.
